{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute response rates by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = df.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].agg(['count', 'sum', 'mean']).round(4)
print("Response rate by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Check distribution of severity and site across arms
print("\nCross-tabulation: arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

print("\nCross-tabulation: arm vs site:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['site']))"}
